prompt:
Use the attached ORIGINAL ASHVEIL SOWER to draw new original poses of the SAME industrial machine. Preserve its four thick hydraulic drive legs and broad support feet, TWO distinct sealed top tanks (tall ribbed seed hopper and shorter round fungus reservoir), short forward soil-optics head, TWO small folded calibration manipulators, ONE downward belly planting spout, closed internal core/power/cooling service panels. No extra legs/tanks, no weapons/scythes/guns or glowing reactor, no animal body. Detailed crisp muted gunmetal/bronze/olive pixel-art clusters, same head/body scale/camera.

Exactly 4 rows x 4 columns on true transparent RGBA. Rows FRONT toward bottom, LEFT front left, RIGHT front right, BACK away toward top (rear cooling vent, no front face). Whole machines are MINIATURE, only central HALF of each cell with very wide transparent gutters. Do not fill cell or clip feet/tanks, no neighbor rectangular crop overlaps. No ground/shadow/scenery/grid/text/labels/checkerboard.

MOTION: slow HEAVY FOUR-LEGGED WALK with FOUR genuinely distinct support phases. Column1 CONTACT A: near forefoot reaches ahead and plants, far foreleg behind, opposite hind foot forward. Column2 PASS A: near forefoot now supports under shoulder and far foreleg lifts/sweeps forward, hind legs pass beneath hips. Column3 CONTACT B: FAR forefoot ahead planted, NEAR foreleg reaches BACK beneath ribs (not forward again), opposite hind foot exchanges too. Column4 PASS B: far forefoot supports under shoulder and NEAR forefoot LIFTS visibly off ground, hind legs pass opposite. Front/back rows clearly alternate viewer-left and viewer-right paw support; side rows must show the near leg behind while far leg leads in column3. Keep broad heavy stable chassis and tanks, minimal body bob, at least two/three support contacts, never airborne or biped. Show piston/joint angles and foot positions changing, not four recolored idle machines. Planting nozzle stays closed and manipulators tucked, no work/spraying effects.
